sections.title: Transposition of the Great Arteries With Atrial Switch

subsections.content: Discusses the outcomes, complications, and management of transposition of the great arteries with an atrial switch operation, including late complications and patient survivorship.
guidelines: Medical therapy for systemic right ventricles, including the use of beta-blockers and evaluation through cardiac magnetic resonance imaging.
Evaluation of right ventricular function post-surgery.

sections.title: Congenitally Corrected Transposition of the Great Arteries

subsections.content: Focuses on the physiology and management of congenitally corrected transposition, including systemic right ventricular function and tricuspid valve regurgitation.
guidelines: Considerations for surgical repair or monitoring of ventricular function.
